result.summary: The Pizza filter is active but non-pizza restaurants are displayed, plus minor truncation of the third restaurant name and inconsistent favorite-icon styling.

issues.description: The 'Pizza' category pill is selected as active, but the visible restaurants do not match: Green Bowl Poke, Smash Bros Burgers, and Tokumaru Ramen Bar (Ramen) are shown.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the restaurant list respects the active category filter, or clear the filter if showing mixed results is intentional

issues.description: The third card in 'Fastest near you' shows the name truncated as 'Trattoria Piccol' with the final letter cut off at the screen edge without ellipsis.
issues.suggestion: Add proper horizontal list padding and use ellipsis truncation for restaurant names so text is not hard-clipped

issues.description: Favorite heart icons are inconsistent: the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows a plain white outline with no background, while the pizza card below shows a heart inside a dark circular background.
issues.suggestion: Use a single consistent favorite button style with a contrasting scrim/background to ensure visibility on all images
